annotation.authors_or_issuer: Presidencia de la República Oriental del Uruguay
key_provisions_or_claims: UNESCO presented the Business Council for the Ethics of AI in Uruguay, linking companies and public sector.
Uruguay proposes legislating to protect rights with open standards while avoiding over-cautious regulation that stifles innovation.
Agesic announced an upcoming citizen participation platform on AI regulation and governance.
Council aims at training business leaders and including the private sector in norm-making.
Ceibal promotes critical thinking about AI in education and girls' STEM participation.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Uruguayan Presidency news item on UNESCO's launch of a Business Council for the Ethics of AI in Uruguay. Officials say Uruguay will legislate to protect rights without over-cautious rules that hinder innovation, and a citizen participation platform on AI regulation is forthcoming. Covers education and data protection; no robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: Empresas y organismos estatales promoverán prácticas éticas en el uso de inteligencia artificial
annotation.title_en: Companies and state bodies will promote ethical practices in the use of artificial intelligence
